description.value: A small stamp with the seal of your sorcerer clan or a different organization you are affiliated with. By spending 1 cursed energy, you can stamp a contract with your seal to agree to a binding vow within the contents of a contract. These are usually used for long and complicated binding vows or to make a binding vow without meeting in person. If the contract or the contents of the contract is changed or altered in any way, the stamp is invalidated and must be reapplied.
